summary: chore(deps): align eslint on ^8.57.1 in every package
description:
Because:

* The packages used seven different eslint ranges, from 6.6.0 to ^8.57.1.

This commit:

* Sets eslint to ^8.57.1 in every package that pins an older version.
* Updates yarn.lock, which drops the eslint 6 and 7 trees.

Closes FXA-9551
